oathCreate.$source: owner: name the Oath first, then add each daily habit with its proof object in a Save / Cancel editor (2026-10-11, DECISIONS D-95, D-96)

oathCreate.habitsSub: Add each daily habit and choose the object you will use as its proof.
oathCreate.editorSub: Choose what you will do, then select the object that proves it.
oathCreate.oneProofNote: Every habit is proven with its own photo, every day.
oathCreate.emptySub: Add your first habit and choose the object that proves it.
oathCreate.proofSummarySub: The phone looks for it in your daily photo of this habit.
oathCreate.noProofSub: Pick one below, or search for another.
oathCreate.unfinishedTitle: A habit has no proof object yet

rematch.winBackHalf: Win back half of what you had left.

core.$source: phase 3: cases the design shows only one sample of (DECISIONS › Copy additions)
core.cancelAlone: You get your {amount} SKR back. This can't be undone.
core.slipped: {names} missed some days. Their lost SKR went to everyone who kept.
core.settlingSub: The pot settles at midnight. Results show here once it does.

proofFeedback.$source: owner: explain which part of a failed photo proof was detected

bounty.$source: phase 4: states the design doesn't draw (DECISIONS › Copy additions)
bounty.noneJoined: No Bounties yet. Discover has free ones to join.
bounty.coverLater: Cover images arrive with Bounty hosting on the server.
bounty.liveUntilDay1: It's in Discover now. Joins close when day 1 ends.

wallet.faucetUsed: The faucet gives 5,000 SKR once per wallet.
wallet.noWalletApp: No wallet app found. Install Phantom or Solflare, or try the demo.

mode.$source: owner: Live and Demo modes (docs/notes/LIVE_DEMO_PLAN.md, DECISIONS D-80)
mode.title: How do you want to start?
mode.exitSub: Wipes the sample account and goes back to the start.
mode.restartSub: Puts the sample account back the way it began.
mode.noServer: This build has no server address, so Live can't start. Try the demo instead.
mode.modelSub: Live proof checks run on this phone. Download about 2.6 GB once, with at least 2.9 GB of free space. Photos are checked on your device.
mode.modelUnsupported: On-device proof checks need a physical 64-bit Android phone. This device cannot run Live proof.
mode.modelDownloadError: The download did not finish. What was downloaded is kept. Check your connection, then resume.
mode.modelStorageError: Not enough free storage. Free up some space, then resume. What was downloaded is kept.
mode.skipSub: Ends today now. Misses cost HP and stake, kept days heal.

deck.$source: owner: Today's Oaths as a swipeable stack (DECISIONS D-85)

recover.$source: owner: crash safety, the root error boundary's recover screen and the unhandled-rejection toast (DECISIONS D-87)
recover.title: Something broke.
recover.sub: That's on us. Nothing you staked or proved is lost. Try again to go back to the app.

session.$source: owner: Live resilience, a token rejected mid-session (DECISIONS D-89)
session.expired: Signed out. Connect your wallet to sign in again.

loadFailed.$source: owner: Live resilience, M2 when a screen's data failed to load for a reason other than the network (DECISIONS D-89)
loadFailed.title: Couldn't load this.
loadFailed.sub: KEPT's server didn't answer, or this is gone. Nothing you staked moved.

camera.$source: Added 2026-10-10 (frontend fix): the shutter failed or timed out; Live never substitutes a photo, so it asks for a retake.
camera.failed: Couldn't take that photo. Try again.

join.$source: owner: E1 starts with a choice, the camera only after Scan is picked (DECISIONS D-91)
join.scanSub: Point your camera at the invite
join.codeSub: Type or paste it, like IRON-7K2Q
join.notInvite: That QR isn't a KEPT invite. Keep scanning.
join.permSub: KEPT uses the camera only to read the invite's QR code. Turn it on in Settings, or type the code instead.

objects.$source: owner: the object picker on C2 (DECISIONS D-94). Labels of the searchable catalog (frontend/src/features/objects/catalog.ts); the proof object is always one of the program's eight.
objects.availableNowSub: These eight are what a photo can be checked for.
objects.noResultsSub: Try a simpler word, or pick one of the objects checked today.
objects.selectedSub: The phone looks for it in your daily photo of this habit.
objects.unavailableToast: Not available yet. For now a photo can be checked for eight objects.
objects.searchMore: Not here? Search every supported object.
objects.searchHint: Search {n} everyday things. Only the ones a photo can be checked for can be picked.

p1.title:
Bet your friends
you'll do it.
p1.sub: Pick a daily habit. Everyone stakes SKR on it. Miss a day and the ones who kept take your share.
p1.a11y: An example Oath, Iron Week, with four friends and 4,000 SKR in the pot. Dev missed a day and paid 100 SKR, shared between the three who kept and KEPT.

p2.title:
One photo per habit.
AI checks it.
p2.sub: Show the object you chose with the gesture the app asks for. An AI model on your phone checks it.
p2.foot: Your photos never leave it. Only the verdict does.
p2.a11y: An example check. The phone looks at the photo and confirms the dumbbell, the thumbs-up gesture, and that it is not a screen. Photos stay on the phone.

p3.title:
Keep your word.
Watch it add up.
p3.sub: Every kept day builds your kept rate, the public score that tells people they can trust you.
p3.foot: An example two-week Oath with two slips. Yours starts on day one.
p3.a11y: An example chart. Over 14 days a person keeps 12, misses two, and ends with a kept rate of {rate} percent and full Oath HP.

proof.$source: owner: one photo per habit (DECISIONS D-98). Strings of the proof screens, Today and the Oath cards; the design's two-photo strings that cannot be amended (templated) are replaced by these.
proof.lineNone: {goal}. One photo per habit before midnight.
proof.f3SubOne: 1 habit left today. Any time before midnight, no timer.
proof.f3SubMany: {left} habits left today. Any time before midnight, no timer.
proof.objectsSub: A photo of {objects} + a hand gesture, for each habit, every day.
proof.groupSub: Send the photo to {names}. Majority approves; a tie rejects. The photo is deleted after the vote, 48 hours at most.
proof.reviewSub: {oath} · day {day} · a photo needs a {object} and {gesture}.

bountyTasks.name: Task name
bountyTasks.unfinishedTitle: A task has no proof object yet
